column1: # The models under test. One row per model; columns are tab-separated.
#   id                  HuggingFace repo id, character for character
#   gated               yes -> needs HF_TOKEN and accepted terms on the model page
#   max_model_len       vLLM context.
#   min_vram_gib        MEASURED floor to run at that context, not estimated.
#   role                why this model is in the sweep at all
# Cosmos3-Edge is the measured baseline. The other three exist to answer questions
# the first run could not: does a bigger model in the same family detect presence
# any better, and does NVIDIA's physical-AI post-training buy anything over the
# base model it started from?
# THE 8B MODELS DO NOT FIT ON A 24 GB CARD AT OUR WINDOW SIZE. Measured, not
# predicted: Qwen3-VL-8B loaded 16.65 GiB of weights on an L4's 22.04 GiB usable,
# leaving 0.65 GiB for KV cache against the 2.25 GiB a 16384 context needs. vLLM
# put the ceiling at 4720 tokens -- too small for a 48-frame window. Raising
# gpu_memory_utilization to fit would need ~0.99, which is not safe.
# Running them anyway, with fewer frames and a shorter context, would break the
# comparison they exist for: Qwen-vs-Reason2 only isolates NVIDIA's post-training
# if both run under conditions identical to each other AND to the 4B baseline.
# Constraints we imposed are not a property of the models. So the 8B rows need a
# 48 GB card (g6e.2xlarge, L40S) and are marked as such rather than quietly run
# in a degraded configuration.
id
nvidia/Cosmos3-Edge
column5: primary — the brief's recommendation, MEASURED: 4.97 of 22.04 GiB used
